title: The gingerbread man.
lines: Once upon a time there was an old woman and an old man.
They lived in a little house near a forest.
They had no children.
One day the old woman said: I'm going to bake a gingerbread man.
She made dough with honey, cinnamon and ginger.
She shaped it into a little man.
With arms and legs.
She gave him raisins for eyes.
A cherry for a mouth.
And three sweets for buttons.
She slid him into the oven.
The whole house smelled delicious.
After a while she opened the oven.
And hop!
The gingerbread man jumped out!
He ran out of the door.
Come back!
shouted the old woman.
Come back!
shouted the old man.
They ran after him.
But the gingerbread man laughed and sang: Run, run, as fast as you can.
You can't catch me, I'm the gingerbread man!
He ran past a cow in the field.
Moo!
said the cow.
You smell so good.
I want to eat you!
But the gingerbread man ran faster.
Run, run, as fast as you can.
You can't catch me, I'm the gingerbread man!
He ran past a horse.
The horse ran after him.
He ran past a pig.
The pig ran after him too.
Everyone wanted to eat him.
A whole line was running after him.
The old woman, the old man, the cow, the horse and the pig.
Then the gingerbread man came to a river.
Oh no.
He couldn't swim.
If he got wet, he would go soft and fall apart.
A fox was sitting by the river.
A sly red fox.
I'll help you, said the fox in a sweet little voice.
Jump onto my tail.
I'll swim you across.
The gingerbread man jumped onto the fox's tail.
The fox swam into the water.
You're getting wet, said the fox.
Jump onto my back.
The gingerbread man jumped onto the fox's back.
You're still getting wet, said the fox.
Jump onto my nose.
The gingerbread man jumped onto the fox's nose.
And snap!
The fox tossed his head up.
He opened his mouth.
But the gingerbread man was clever.
He had already worked it out.
He jumped off the fox's nose.
Right onto a big leaf floating on the water.
The leaf floated to the other side.
The gingerbread man jumped onto dry land.
Bye, fox!
he shouted.
You can't catch me, I'm the gingerbread man!
And he ran away.
Into the forest.
And nobody has ever caught him since.
The end.
